caption: Figure 46: MSE monitored parameters while drilling the 8-3/4 in. hole section (Bit # 11)

data.transcription: The figure is a multi-line graph showing various drilling parameters over time and depth. The axes are labeled as follows: the vertical axis represents Depth FT, with values ranging from 0 to 7650 feet; the horizontal axis represents Time, starting at February 21, 2021, and ending on February 23, 2021. The graph includes several series representing different drilling parameters such as MSE Total (Mechanical Specific Energy), Convertible Torque, Weight on Bit, On Bottom ROP (Rate of Penetration), Differential Pressure, Bit RPM (Rotary RPM), Depth of Cut, and Bit Torque.
data.description: The figure provides a detailed view of the drilling process for well 56-32. It shows how various parameters such as mechanical specific energy, torque, weight on bit, rate of penetration, differential pressure, and other operational metrics change with depth and time during the drilling operation. This data is crucial for understanding the performance of the drill string and identifying any anomalies or changes in drilling conditions.
